jcr_content.jcr:description: Macnica Americas offers lifetime automotive technical solutions, production support, global traceability, and more, across North America. Get info here!

image_1.alt: Automotive production tech graphic with open hands

text_1.text:
Through the entire product lifecycle, Macnica Americas supports North American customers with technical/commercial guidance for their automotive production support, automotive technology solutions and product needs.

Comprehensive Design Support

  • Global platform support
  • Japan and local design support

Highest Quality

  • Global PCN management
  • Global traceability control (LOT, Date Code 24/7)
  • PPAP  (including PSW and IMDS support)
  • FAR (48 hours first response, 10 days final)

Competitive Costs

  • Volume purchase agreements based on global volume
  • Regional and global negotiation
  • Blanket PO support and consignment inventory
  • PCN/PDN and End-of-life support

Just-In-Time Delivery

  • Experienced JIT warehouse with over 22 years of experience
  • Certified to TS14949 and ISO9001:2008
  • Real-time inventory management (WMS)
  • Over 99.9% on-time delivery

Request more information about our automotive electronics technical services or call our Automotive Office at 847-701-8245.
